note: PHASE 3, no IMSLP candidates (all 19 composers have 0 IMSLP works). Sources: composer or publisher work lists (Montgomery, Mazzoli, Leon, Norman, Snider, Shaw's store), Wikipedia lists, Apple Music composerTerm searches and Deezer album pages for the recordings. Apple matches are fuzzy: every kept title was matched to the composer's own list or to a performing ensemble that fixes the scoring. USAGE LIMIT: the run was cut short, so Simon (all), Moore, Hailstork (only the Detroit quintet), Marsalis (A Fiddler's Tale), Frank (Hilos, Quijotadas, Kanto Kechua, Inca Dances, Milagros), Esmail (Zeher), Sierra (Kandinsky), Baker (Bay Chamber pieces), Roumain and Perkinson (rest) are marked 'not checked (usage limit)'; 'not performed or recorded' lines rest on a weak Apple/Deezer search. Scoring was inferred from the performers for Three Essays, Microfictions, Leyendas, Calvary, Roots II, Sierra's quartet/trios and Shotgun Houses (confidence medium). The eight violin-catalogue entries in the input (444, 4342, 4345, 4419, 4425, 4494, 4496, 4716) are duos or string orchestra: none is cross-listed. Gran Turismo (violin octet) is skipped because the checker rejects violins-only scorings; the owner may rule. The Companion Guide to Rome rests on a Chamber Music Conference faculty release (A Far Cry's disc may be the string-orchestra version): confidence low.
